payload.title: Kigali Student Housing Survey
payload.html: Kigali Student Housing Survey

Help CMU students find fair housing in Kigali.
We are CMU students building the first open map of student rent prices in Kigali. Share one place you rented (or are looking for) and we will send you the results: a price map by neighbourhood.

⏱ About 6 minutes (about 3 minutes if you are adding another stay). One question per screen: you can go back at any time to change an answer.
🔒 Anonymous. Landlords, agents and unit numbers are never published. Results are shown in aggregate only.
